reports.notes: Shown only in 8.PNG (radio 'External Incoming Referral Management' filled, right column row 4). REFERRED TO PROVIDER (left) and REFERRED FROM (right) are side by side; other sections full width. Unlike External Outgoing / Internal, no PROCEDURE CODES, USERS or SPECIALTY sections are visible for this report, and no GROUP BY. A 16 px strip of blank panel background (y=519-534) is visible between the last CONTACT STATUSES row and the action bar - the same background that fills the empty area of the short reports - so the criteria end there and the report is treated as complete, though the margin is small. Checkboxes are listed row by row (left to right); grid position is in each control's notes. Nothing is greyed out; the individual status checkboxes are drawn enabled while All is checked.

observations: All 8 screenshots (1366 px wide, 582-589 px high) are plain, unscrolled views of the same Denticon screen, each with a different report selected (1.PNG..8.PNG = the 8 listed reports in list order), so every report has exactly one screenshot and none is missing. Title bar: 'Referral Reports' at the left; 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a printer icon at the far right. Left panel header 'SELECT REPORT' lists the 8 reports as radio buttons in a 2-column x 4-row grid; the list is fully visible (uniform empty dark area below it, no scrollbar, nothing clipped). A small splitter/collapse handle (three dots) sits on the divider between the two panels. Right panel header 'REPORT CRITERIA' carries a grey 'CLEAR CRITERIA' button (refresh icon) at its right end; a fixed action bar at the bottom of the criteria panel holds the blue buttons 'PRINT / PREVIEW' (printer icon) and 'ADD TO MY FAVORITES' (plus icon). No footer text. No dropdown is expanded and no picker popup is open in any screenshot, so the value lists behind REFERRAL TYPE, SPECIALTY, REFERRED TO/BY and behind every SELECT picker (offices, office groups, providers, referred-to / referred-from / referral-out-to sources, users, procedure codes, patient types) are not visible anywhere in this category and must be captured separately. Recurring patterns: every report starts with PRINT FORMAT (PDF / Excel, PDF selected). Office scope is an Office / Office Group radio pair (Office selected) plus an unlabelled read-only box with a blue SELECT button; the box defaults to 108 (the OID in the title bar). The section is titled OFFICE/GROUP, REFERRED FROM OFFICE/GROUP or REFERRED TO OFFICE/GROUP depending on the report, and Internal Referral Management shows both From (108) and To (ALL) side by side. Referral Source List is the only report where the office radios and SELECT button are greyed out. Date sections are titled PROCEDURE DATE RANGE (Referral Production List, Referral Summary Report, Referral Count Summary), REFERRED OUT DATE RANGE (Referred Out List) or REFERRAL DATE RANGE (the three Management reports); Referral Source List has no date range. Populated date fields show 11/21/2026 (apparently the capture date) with a calendar icon inside the field; the FIRST VISIT DATE RANGE fields are empty with a grey 'Select Date' placeholder. Multi-select filters are unlabelled read-only boxes (default ALL, or None for EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE) with a blue SELECT button whose icon varies: building = office/office group and PROCEDURE CODES, single person = provider pickers, person-plus = USERS / REFERRED TO / REFERRED FROM / REFERRAL OUT TO / EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE. Pickers, dropdowns and the radio rows have no field label of their own (label left empty; the section header serves as the label). Referral Summary Report and Referral Count Summary show identical criteria. Status vocabularies: External Outgoing and External Incoming use a 3-column checkbox grid (All, Accepted, Rejected, Pending, Cancelled, Completed, In Progress, Not Needed, Expired; only All checked); Internal uses radios (All, Completed, Incomplete; All selected); External Incoming adds CONTACT STATUSES (All, No Response, Patient To Call, Appointment Scheduled, Referral Refused; only All checked); 'Exclude Deleted Referrals' (checked) is visible on Internal and External Incoming. Text fidelity: at this resolution the bold upper-case section-header font draws capital G almost like C (the headers look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'DATE RANCE', 'CROUP BY'). A pixel-level comparison of the two glyphs inside the same header (the C of CODE vs the G of RANGE in ZIP CODE RANGE; the C of OFFICE vs the G of GROUP) shows the G carries a heavier lower-right spur that the C lacks, and the regular-weight radio label 'Office Group' shows a clear G, so these headers are transcribed as GROUP / RANGE / GROUP BY. Genuine legacy typo kept as displayed: 'REFFERED TO PROVIDER' (Internal Referral Management, 7.PNG); the same wording is spelt correctly as 'REFERRED TO PROVIDER' on External Incoming (8.PNG). The header 'FIRST VISIT DATE RANGE ( LEAVE BLANK FOR ALL PATIENTS )' is displayed with spaces inside the parentheses. Truncation: the criteria content runs underneath the fixed action bar and no scrollbar is drawn anywhere. In 7.PNG (Internal Referral Management) only the top 15 px of the GROUP BY header (with its text) is visible - its controls are hidden. In 4.PNG (External Outgoing Referral Management) the third STATUSES row ends flush against the bar with no closing separator line or blank panel background, so further rows/sections may be hidden. A scrolled capture of both reports is needed to complete them. The other six reports end with blank panel background above the action bar (only 16 px of it in 8.PNG) and are complete. A sweep of every ink cluster in each criteria panel found no further controls: no right-edge checkboxes such as Page Break, no icons beside fields other than the calendar icons, and no instruction text other than the FIRST VISIT header.
